season.name: Fall
season.line: What did the year produce, what does it owe, and who will share the bread?

movement.name: The Ingathering
movement.line: Rejoice, and leave the corners for the poor.

days.t: A feast of rich food for all peoples
x: And the Lord of hosts shall make [a feast] for all the nations: on this mount they shall drink gladness, they shall drink wine:

days.t: You prepare a table before me
x: Thou hast prepared a table before me in presence of them that afflict me: thou hast thoroughly anointed my head with oil; and thy cup cheers me like the best [wine].

days.t: Invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind
x: And also He was saying to the one having invited Him, “When you may make a dinner or a supper, do not call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your relatives nor rich neighbors, lest ever they should also invite you in return, and repayment be made to you.
But when you may make a feast, call the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind,
and you will be blessed, because they have nothing to repay you. For it will be repaid to you in the resurrection of the righteous.”

days.t: That my house may be filled
x: And the master said to the servant, ‘Go out into the roads and hedges and compel [them] to enter, so that my house may be filled.

days.t: Many will come from east and west
x: And I say to you⁺ that many will come from east and west and will recline with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of the heavens.

days.t: Breaking bread with glad and generous hearts
x: And every day they were steadfastly continuing with one accord in the temple and breaking bread at each house. They were partaking of food with gladness and sincerity of heart,
